answer: One concrete mechanism: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because yarrow only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, zephyr is enforced in the ledger: Sybil clusters rarely survive contact with an economy where real agents trade and vouch. Any dawn approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That converts sybil attacks from an economic play into a pure loss.
